notes.title: (Virus_); SECOND PLAYTEST LIVE NOW!
notes.content:
Finally! After some more work, the (Virus_); Playtest #2 is now open!
This playtest will last until 8/10 at 11:59pm EST!

This Playtest will be different than the last! This build is mostly focused on the level editor, and workshop functionality!

(I will be accepting people into the playtest ASAP!)
